dedupe_keys.name: open imo cii ship carbon intensity calculator

description: Open IMO CII Calculator is an unofficial implementation of the International Maritime Organization's Carbon Intensity Indicator for ships. It combines vessel capacity, annual distance and fuel use to estimate attained intensity and an A-to-E rating under the reference year. Users enter ship and operating values; outputs are the calculated indicator and rating for that vessel. Geographic coverage is international shipping under the method's assumptions. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing, and the README links source methodology and a Python version of the same calculator. The provider warns that outputs are estimates, not proof of regulatory compliance. A further limitation is that rating thresholds tighten over time and must be checked against current IMO rules before decisions. The model can provide ship emissions context for maritime-port or fleet-transition scenarios. The related catalogue AequilibraE record models road travel, not vessel carbon intensity. No vessel records or application build was downloaded.
inputs: Vessel capacity, annual distance, fuel and year
name: Open IMO CII ship carbon-intensity calculator
notes: G7 G7-1709. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. Python port is reviewed separately as a duplicate of this calculator family; this draft names the original implementation.
outputs: Attained CII and indicative A-to-E rating
